from common import *
import gzip
if __name__=='__main__':
 source(__file__)
 assert read(STATE)['status']=='stopping'
 state=read(PROGRESS);assert state['status']=='completed' and len(state['jobs'])==2 and all(j['status']=='succeeded' for j in state['jobs'])
 allowed={'account.py','cleanup.py','common.py','finalize.py','finalize_reports.py','init_accounts.py','prepare.py','prepare_v2.py','promote.py','sync_baseline_docs.py','prepare_closure.py','ladder.log','s5.log','cleanup-dryrun.json','cleanup-final-dryrun.json','__pycache__'}
 assert {p.name for p in TMP.iterdir()}==allowed
 inventory=[]
 for p in sorted(TMP.rglob('*')):
  if not p.is_file():continue
  f=fp(p)
  if p.suffix=='.py':
   receipt=read(BT/'docs'/('adapter-'+p.stem+'.json'))
   assert receipt['source']==f and receipt['source_text']==p.read_text()
   permanent=fp(BT/'docs'/('adapter-'+p.stem+'.json'))
  elif p.suffix=='.log':
   dest=BT/'docs'/f'{p.stem}-account.log.gz';assert gzip.decompress(dest.read_bytes())==p.read_bytes();permanent=fp(dest)
  elif p.suffix=='.json':
   dest=BT/'docs'/p.name;assert fp(dest)['sha256']==f['sha256'];permanent=fp(dest)
  else:
   assert p.parent==TMP/'__pycache__' and p.name=='common.cpython-312.pyc'
   permanent={'reason':'Task-local compiled common.py cache; exact source archived'}
  inventory.append({'temporary':f,'preserved_as':permanent})
 plan=BT/'docs/temporary-cleanup-manifest.json';write(plan,{'temporary_root':str(TMP),'entries':inventory,'purpose':'Exact task-owned one-off tools/logs; all source/log/cleanup evidence archived before deletion.'})
 for x in inventory:
  check(x['temporary']);Path(x['temporary']['path']).unlink()
 (TMP/'__pycache__').rmdir();TMP.rmdir();assert not TMP.exists()
 audit=BT/'docs/harness-cleanup.json'
 write(audit,{'result':'no_changes','mlruns':'handled','temporary':'cleaned','result_evidence':fp(BT/'docs/cleanup-final-dryrun.json'),'retention_evidence':fp(BT/'docs/retention-verification.json'),'temporary_manifest':fp(plan),'temporary_root_absent':not TMP.exists(),'temporary_files_deleted':len(inventory),'temporary_bytes_deleted':sum(x['temporary']['size'] for x in inventory),'mlruns_action':'Two new registered recorders retained as necessary exact source account/positions/indicators; inspected individually. No unreferenced new MLflow artifacts. Existing unrelated MLflow experiments untouched.','new_fits':0,'completed_account_jobs':2})
 harness('event',{'type':'cleanup','outcome':'complete','audit':str(audit.relative_to(ROOT))})
 harness('event',{'type':'close'})
 status=harness('status')
 write(BT/'docs/completion.json',{'native_status':status['status'],'native_revision':status['revision'],'native_variants':len(status['variants']),'supplementary_account_jobs':2,'new_model_fits':0,'model_baseline':MODEL_ID,'strategy_baseline':'baseline/phase-m-v1-bt-v5','scientific_verification':fp(BT/'docs/scientific-verification.json'),'report_verification':fp(BT/'docs/registration-report-verification.json'),'cleanup':fp(audit),'temporary_root_absent':True,'coverage_note':'Native strategy result gate pins historical v2; actual v5 accounts verified separately, never represented as v2 native variants.','visual_preview':'Browser local-file protocol blocked; static checks completed.'})
 print(json.dumps({'status':status['status'],'revision':status['revision'],'accounts':2,'new_fits':0,'temp_removed':not TMP.exists()},ensure_ascii=False))
